name: Silver Samurai

abilityDetails.Daunted: Rakibin özel saldırılar sonrasında hasar almasını kolaylaştırır.
abilityDetails.Overload: Vuruşlar, yakın zamanda verilen hasarın bir kısmını ek enerji hasarı olarak verir.
abilityDetails.Power Efficiency: Özel saldırıların güç maliyetini belirtilen güçte azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Silver Shogun
Silver Samurai lives for the big fight, yearning for a challenge. At the start of a Battlegrounds or final Quest node fight, he grants the Opponent 20 Combo Meter and he gains a [13 - 30]% Power Efficiency Passive for 30 seconds.
Each hit of Special Attacks 1 and 2 gain +[6.06 - 144.85] Critical Rating per Daunted on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Bushido ~ The Way of the Samurai
content: Silver Samurai can generate tachyon charges within his own body, making all his attacks deal Energy Damage and granting him 100% Resistance to Bleed effects.
Silver Samurai always believes in a fair fight, granting his Opponent a Combo Shield Passive while their Combo Meter is at or below 100.
While the Opponent's Combo Meter is below 80, Silver Samurai's second Medium Attack grants them 10 Combo Meter.
If striking a non-Stunned Opponent, the first hit of Silver Samurai's Heavy Attack grants them 10 Combo Meter.
If Silver Samurai's Heavy Attack is cancelled into a Special Attack, grant the Opponent 10 Combo Meter.

abilitySections.title: Daunted - Max: 25
content: When Silver Samurai consumes the Opponent's Combo, they are inflicted with an indefinite 8% Daunted Passive for every 5 Combo consumed.
When Silver Samurai is knocked down, 1 personal Daunted is removed.
While the Opponent has at least 50 Combo Meter or is suffering from 8+ Daunteds, Silver Samurai prepares for impact, gaining a Reinforce Passive.

abilitySections.title: Break Their Form
content: While Silver Samurai is Unblockable, the Opponent is inflicted with a 35% Overload Passive.

After Silver Samurai consumes the Opponent's Combo Meter, if the Opponent is suffering from 16+ Daunted effects, he gains an Unblockable Passive for 7 seconds, paused during Special Attacks and Strikers. This will not trigger while already active.
When this Unblockable expires, remove 50% of Silver Samurai's personal Daunteds. Against Tech Champions, remove 66% instead.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation and on the first two hits of this attack, consume up to 10 Combo from the Opponent's Combo Meter.
During this attack, increase the potency of Silver Samurai's Overload Passives by 10% per Daunted on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The first hit consumes up to 100 Combo from the Opponent's Combo Meter.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a non-stacking 35% Power Efficiency Passive for 30 seconds.
Inflict a non-stacking 15% Overload Passive for 60 seconds.

Each hit of Special Attacks 1 and 2 gain +[6.06 - 144.85] Critical Rating per Daunted on the Opponent.
